channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Qatar and Turkiye sign a mutual defence pact: What do we know?
item.description: Analysts say the pact, agreed amid the US-Iran war, aims to deter attacks rather than build an offensive alliance.

item.title: UN says 25 seafarers killed in, around Hormuz since US-Israel war on Iran
item.description: 'Situation cannot become new normal', says UN's Khaled Khiari, as Iran reports three more vessels hitting mines.

item.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
item.description: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.
